prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but first a few quick questions so I can give useful, tailored recommendations:

- How badly were you injured (minor aches, medical treatment, hospitalization, permanent injury)?  
- When did the accident happen? (date)  
- Was there a police report? Do you have the other driver’s insurance info?  
- Have you already seen a doctor?  
- Are you looking for a local Pleasanton attorney or are nearby cities (Dublin, San Ramon, Walnut Creek, Livermore, Oakland) ok?

While you answer, here’s practical guidance to help you choose the right lawyer and protect your claim right away.

Immediate steps (if you haven’t already)
- Get medical care now and follow doctors’ orders — medical records are critical.  
- File/obtain the police report and exchange insurance info.  
- Take and keep photos of injuries, vehicle damage, scene, skid marks, traffic signs, and clothing.  
- Preserve evidence (car parts, dashcam footage, witness contact info).  
- Don’t give a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer or sign any settlement/release without an attorney.  
- Note: California’s general personal injury statute of limitations is 2 years from the accident date (shorter deadlines may apply for claims against government agencies). If your accident is recent, contact counsel promptly.

What type of lawyer to look for
- Specialization: a personal injury / car-accident attorney (not a criminal or family lawyer).  
- Experience: several years handling auto-accident cases and trial experience (not every case settles).  
- Track record: verdicts and settlements in similar cases, especially for injuries like yours.  
- Resources: firm can front costs for medical record retrieval, expert witnesses, accident reconstruction if needed.  
- Communication: clear point of contact, timely replies, and a simple explanation of fees and process.  
- Fee structure: most auto injury lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you recover), usually 33–40% plus costs — confirm percentages and when costs are repaid.  
- Local knowledge: familiarity with local courts, hospitals, and insurers can help.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How long have you handled car-accident cases? What percent of your practice is auto injury?  
- Who will handle my case (attorney name vs. paralegal)? Will you go to trial if needed?  
- What similar cases have you resolved and what were the outcomes?  
- What is your fee and how are costs handled? Any retainer?  
- How often and by what method will you update me?  
- Do you have client references?  
- Do you foresee any potential problems with my case? What is a realistic settlement range?

What to bring to the consultation
- Police report (if available), photos, videos, names/contact info of witnesses, insurance info for the other driver, your medical records/doctor notes/bills, pay stubs if you missed work, receipts for out-of-pocket expenses, and any correspondence from insurers.

How I can help next
- If you want, I can compile a short vetted list (3–6) of personal injury attorneys near Pleasanton with reviews, office locations, and phone numbers so you can call for free consultations. Tell me whether you prefer boutique/smaller firms or larger firms, any language needs, and whether you want an attorney who will take the case to trial if necessary.

Tell me the answers to the quick questions above and whether you want that list, and I’ll prepare options for you.
